summary: Tears down two double-buffered object arrays: when the buffer pointer at this+0x694 is non-null, runs ObjectDestructor on each of 45 elements (stride 4 over 180 bytes), frees the buffer via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and nulls the pointer; repeats for the pointer at this+0x6D8; then clears the active flag byte this+0x4 to 0 and returns the last free result. Called from sub_4C6E80 (0x004C6E80) and StructReinitHelper (0x004F8370).

local_names.this: struct owning the two double-buffered arrays
local_names.i/j: loop indices stepping 4 bytes over the 180-byte element arrays

operations.description: Guard on the dword at this+0x694: teardown of the first buffer proceeds only when it is non-null.
Loop i from 0 in steps of 4 while i < 180, calling ObjectDestructor on (this+0x694 buffer base + i), destroying each of the 45 array elements.
Free the first buffer with FreeWrapper_7bcf(*(this+0x694)) and store its result, then write 0 to the dword at this+0x694.
Guard on the dword at this+0x6D8: teardown of the second buffer proceeds only when it is non-null.
Loop j from 0 in steps of 4 while j < 180, calling ObjectDestructor on (this+0x6D8 buffer base + j), destroying each of the 45 array elements.
Free the second buffer with FreeWrapper_7bcf(*(this+0x6D8)) and store its result, then write 0 to the dword at this+0x6D8.
Write 0 to the byte at this+0x4, clearing the active flag after both buffers are freed.
Return the last free result (result of the second FreeWrapper_7bcf, or the first when only one buffer was present).

unresolved: The element type of the two 45-element arrays is unknown; ObjectDestructor is a generic vtable-destruction helper whose concrete type dispatch is outside this function.
The exact object type owning the double buffers is unknown (owner UNKNOWN).
Whether the 45-element count (180 bytes / 4-byte stride) reflects a fixed 45-slot array or a size coincidence is not confirmed by packet evidence.
